sourcify.evidence: Sourcify match 1605500 identifies WETH9 compiled with Solidity 0.4.19. Its creation and runtime bytecode are verified matches. The runtime bytecode returned by Sourcify hashes to the same value as eth_getCode at block 25850638.

proxy.evidence: Sourcify reports isProxy=false. The verified WETH9 runtime implements deposit() directly and contains no delegatecall-based dispatch path.

displayBindings.rationale: The immutable, non-proxy deposit() implementation credits msg.value directly to balanceOf[msg.sender]. It reads no administrator-controlled configuration that can change the Wrap intent or the displayed native-currency amount.
